verdict.rationale: AMD's own docs explicitly list Linux x86 64-bit OS support and dedicated ROCm documentation for Linux PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX/ONNX plus vLLM and Llama.cpp support, showing Linux is a documented first-class target. However, the evidence pack contains no independent/third-party Linux benchmarking or hands-on testing reports corroborating real-world Linux performance or driver stability. Missing for 10: independent Linux reviews/benchmarks, community driver-stability reports, release-note cadence evidence for Linux driver updates.
